request: 接入新总览和八峰内景；总览先按既有八峰方位补齐各自可辨认的地标。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and layout correction. One finished Chinese cultivation RPG sect panorama, horizontal 16:9, target 1672x941 pixels. Image 1 is the original implemented EIGHT-DISTRICT composition reference; Image 2 is the new approved matte palette and vast mountains reference but has too few recognizable districts; Image 3 is ONLY the approved matte pigment and brush style. Repaint the mountain domain so ALL EIGHT MAIN DISTRICTS from Image 1 remain geographically identifiable, retaining their approximate screen positions. Critical: do not reduce them to three palace groups as in Image 2. All eight districts must have their own recognizable functional landmark, genuinely in the art, not just empty cloud positions waiting for names. There is NO text or UI in this image.

Eight main districts and approximate normalized landmark locations, measured from top-left: (1) Zifu at (0.50,0.23), tallest middle-back sacred summit with grand governing halls and a processional stair. (2) Xuanlan at (0.28,0.27), upper-left cliffside multistorey scripture archive and narrow galleries. (3) Tianwen at (0.72,0.27), upper-right open circular stone practice platforms, few roofs. (4) Heguang at (0.25,0.47), left-middle working terraces and stores/open service halls. (5) Zhizhong at (0.68,0.47), right-middle bronze-bell pavilion and a solemn discipline hall behind. (6) Guanfu at (0.26,0.68), lower-left stepped residential and teaching roofs beside a small mountain lake. (7) Tiangong at (0.50,0.68), lower-middle staggered roofed craft galleries with a small furnace vapor plume. (8) Yaopu at (0.76,0.68), lower-right curving planted medicinal terraces, water channel and pond. Positions may vary slightly for coherent terrain, but retain their relative relationships and keep major landmarks within x18%-82%, y16%-80%. Each UI label will later sit in a narrow quiet rock/ground area beside its landmark, so keep a small nearby calm area without covering the landmark with more roofs. Do not draw visible label plates, signboards, bubbles, captions or blank graphic placeholders.

This is an immense FIRST-RANK IMMORTAL SECT spanning unbounded mountain ranges, NOT eight little isolated courtyard-islands that can be counted, not eight equal round plots, not a miniature diorama or ordinary rural town. Use huge continuous broken ridges and sharp cliff shoulders, overlap and conceal subsidiary structures behind mountain masses, let foreground/lateral roofbands and slopes continue out of frame, include many distant minor peaks and glimpses of additional sect architecture. Main eight functional centers are partial views of vast districts embedded in the mountain realm, not eight completely contained compounds. Zifu dominates elevation but not the whole image. Some districts have mostly terraces, platforms or vegetation rather than halls. Deep ravines and broad painted cloud layers create spatial separation while actual continuous mountain geology connects the realm. Roads are restrained, short and grounded; no giant S-shaped road, road roundabout, bridge spaghetti or geometrically impossible sky bridges. Any staircase has a real supporting slope and landings, any bridge must join same-height rock ledges on both ends.

Use exactly Image 2 and Image 3's subdued matte hand-painted palette: blue-grey mountains and roofs, olive/grey-green pines, warm grey stone, off-white plaster and restrained muted ochre timber, gentle midtone contrast. Broad clean gouache/watercolor planes and form-following brushwork. No dense white/gold stippling, speckled rocks, sparkling foliage, white blossoms scattered on every tree, glitter, photographic rendering or 3D look. Keep all four edges/corners clear and fully painted, NO vignette, blurred periphery, fading white paper borders or bokeh. Natural painted valley clouds are allowed but not blank formless fog hiding every district. High oblique aerial view with very deep mountain layers, no low ground camera. No humans, humanoid statues, readable writing, UI, watermark or framing. Keep the grand mountain scale and cohesive pigment style while correcting the missing eight-district geography.
